name: AI Translate Paragraph Asymetric
description: Provides one-click AI-powered translation for asymmetric paragraphs.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Features 
 
 Asymmetric Translation Capabilities : This module enables users to leverage AI translations from the AI Module specifically for paragraphs configured to be asymmetric. 
 Integration with Paragraphs Asymmetric Translation Widgets : The functionality is made possible through seamless integration with the Paragraphs Asymmetric Translation Widgets module. 
 
 Back to top 

 Post-Installation Steps 
 After installing the module, please ensure the following configurations:

 
 Translatable Fields : Ensure that the fields referencing paragraphs are configured to be translatable. 
 Non-Translatable Paragraph Fields : Make sure that the paragraph fields themselves are not set to be translatable. 
 AI Translation Configuration : In the AI translation configuration, enable "Paragraph" for entity reference translation by navigating to /admin/config/ai/ai_translate . 
 Out of the Box Functionality : The module should work seamlessly once the above settings are configured. 
 
 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 To successfully use this module, ensure the following modules are enabled:

 
 AI Translate submodule from AI Module 
 Paragraphs Asymmetric Translation Widgets
